scope: Requested visible dormer / wing / pitched canopy repairs, real LOW-HIGH comparison and direct Houdini GUI provenance; not all-angle production certification.

observed.all_16_heroes: Reviewed as four sheets and representative full native window captures. Complete buildings remain framed at one common hero camera.
observed.06_tavern: Dormer front now meets the host slope; dormer roof has tiles. Wing roof has tiles without the former Skin bridge. Front/roof/rear and LOW-HIGH details retained.
observed.07_weapon_guild: Main and secondary roof levels remain distinct; wing slopes are tiled. Dormer seats on the host. Rear view retained.
observed.08_normal_house_b: Dormer has a tiled cap and embedded front base. Pitched entrance canopy has visible tiles and diagonal wall braces; close capture retained.
observed.11_artisan_house: Lower wing roof has tiles, thickness and a terminating ridge against the tall wall; entrance canopy retains its support braces. Front roof and rear view retained.
observed.low_high: Same-camera close captures show the bevel geometry in HIGH; LOW/HIGH topology counts and position hashes are separately measured.
observed.network: Actual native Houdini network window screenshots accompany the HOM graph audit; no drawn UI substitutes.

limits: Common hero views do not establish structural support or collision validity for all hidden surfaces and arbitrary parameter combinations.

The fabric awning of variant 10 is not prominent in the shared hero view. Projection and support recook are measured in the mesh; its presentation is not treated as a complete reference-fidelity pass.
HIGH is feature-limited native bevel geometry with architectural detail. Sculpted wood/stone damage, final textures, a new normal bake and Unreal review are not included.
